_about: laneTOP20A CombatCues.cs. enabled false (shipped default) = the component is not created, the game is unchanged. wrongSide: a toast when the PLAYER's raised guard faced the attacker but its side did not cover the swing (controls.json guard.match), so the blow went through as a clean hit. exhausted: a toast when the player's stamina hits 0 plus a pulsing red screen edge while DuelFighter.Exhausted lasts (stamina.json exhausted{}: walk x0.85, damage x0.75, no parry, slow guard raise, heavies refused). seconds = toast time, sizeFrac / yFrac = font size and vertical position as fractions of screen height, edgeAlpha / edgeWidthFrac / edgeHz = edge pulse. Colours r,g,b,a.
